_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere mandatory acceptance obligations; planned evidence is not completion.

requirements.title: Vanilla regression
requirements.description: Given a non-Portal vanilla consumer is generated, when the extension mechanism is present, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: The ordinary package still builds and runs.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-01 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: The ordinary package still builds and runs. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Unknown extension
requirements.description: Given a package declares an unsupported extension version, when generation starts, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: It fails with a typed compatibility reason.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-02 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: It fails with a typed compatibility reason. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Clean install
requirements.description: Given a primary host has no prior Portal installation, when the candidate installs, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: Its declared profile opens with correct readiness.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-03 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: Its declared profile opens with correct readiness. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Update continuity
requirements.description: Given a supported predecessor contains user state, when the candidate updates it, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: Conversation state and helper identity are preserved.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-04 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: Conversation state and helper identity are preserved. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Interrupted update
requirements.description: Given an update is interrupted, when the app recovers, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: It runs a coherent version or reports recovery without corrupt state.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-05 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: It runs a coherent version or reports recovery without corrupt state. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Uninstall policy
requirements.description: Given the user chooses the documented retention option, when uninstall runs, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: Only owned artifacts are removed accordingly.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-06 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: Only owned artifacts are removed accordingly. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Artifact identity
requirements.description: Given a candidate was tested, when release readiness is evaluated, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: Its digest matches the tested bytes.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-07 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: Its digest matches the tested bytes. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Native privilege isolation
requirements.description: Given a package loads remote scenario content, when the content attempts host access, scenario-to-desktop shall ensure: Sandbox and IPC policy deny it.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case PKG-08 in the scenario-to-desktop producer suite. Required assertion: Sandbox and IPC policy deny it. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.
